en_title: Dragon Ball’s Goku Voice Actor 'Furious' Over AI Videos Using Her Voice Without Permission
cn_title: 野泽雅子怒斥AI擅用声音如同盗窃
subtitle: 声音相似，却没有心
opus_summary: 野泽雅子怒斥AI视频未经许可使用她的声音，称此举如同盗窃，并强调表演需要真情实感。她担任副理事长的日本演员联盟已推出AI声音使用指南，希望推动立法。

paragraphs.en: Masako Nozawa, best known for voicing Goku in the Dragon Ball anime series, is slamming AI users for stealing her voice to create projects using the rapidly advancing technology, calling it outright “theft.”
paragraphs.cn: 以在《龙珠》动画系列中为悟空配音而闻名的野泽雅子，近日怒斥一些AI使用者盗用她的声音，利用这项飞速发展的技术制作作品，直言这种行为就是「盗窃」。

paragraphs.en: If you’re an anime fan, you’ve likely seen a few fan-made videos that use AI to copy characters’ voices, making them say some absolutely outrageous stuff. This trend isn't limited to English-speaking fanbases; it's also happening quite frequently in Japan, to the point where voice actors have gathered together to create the country’s first-ever guidelines regarding the use of AI voices.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你是动画爱好者，可能已经看过一些粉丝自制视频：制作者用AI模仿角色的声音，让角色说出一些极其离谱的话。这种现象不仅出现在英语粉丝群体中，在日本也相当常见，甚至促使配音演员们联合起来，制定了日本首份AI声音使用指南。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the most prominent of these actors is 89-year-old Nozawa. She’s a prolific voice actor who has been working in the space for decades and is best known as the voice of Goku (as well as Son Gohan and oodles of Goku variants) in Dragon Ball .
paragraphs.cn: 在这些配音演员中，最知名的或许就是89岁的野泽雅子。她从业数十年，配音作品众多，最为人熟知的角色是《龙珠》中的悟空，此外她还为孙悟饭以及众多不同版本的悟空配音。

paragraphs.en: In an October 15 interview with Japanese outlet NHK , Nozawa was shown an AI video that used her voice — and her response to it was nothing short of scathing.
paragraphs.cn: 10月15日接受日本媒体NHK采访时，野泽雅子观看了一段使用她声音的AI视频，随后毫不留情地批评了这种做法。

paragraphs.en: "That's not my voice,” she told the outlet. “I can't forgive them for using it without permission; it's like theft, and it makes me furious. I believe my voice and my acting are my own. If they're going to use even a little bit of it, they should get my permission.
paragraphs.cn: 她告诉NHK：「那不是我的声音。他们未经许可就使用，我无法原谅；这就像盗窃，让我非常愤怒。我认为，我的声音和表演都属于我自己。哪怕只用一点，也应该征得我的许可。」

paragraphs.en: "The AI-generated voice may resemble me. It may even be identical. But it lacks heart, doesn't it? Without heart, it's no good, no matter what the role. Even if it's just a crying voice, I believe it's different if you cry with emotion."
paragraphs.cn: 「AI生成的声音或许很像我，甚至可能一模一样。但它没有心，不是吗？无论演什么角色，没有心都不行。哪怕只是哭声，我也相信，带着感情哭出来就是不一样。」

paragraphs.en: On September 30, the Tokyo District Court ruled that the unauthorized use of someone’s voice infringes upon their right to publicity in a landmark decision for both the voice acting industry and AI regulations as a whole. It’s one of Japan’s first major protections against AI, and it follows a lawsuit from famous voice actor Kenjiro Tsuda against TikTok over a video that used AI to imitate his voice.
paragraphs.cn: 9月30日，东京地方法院裁定，未经许可使用他人声音，侵犯了当事人的公开权（right to publicity）。这一判决对配音行业乃至整体AI监管都具有里程碑意义，也是日本最早针对AI提供的重大法律保护之一。此前，知名配音演员津田健次郎因一段利用AI模仿其声音的视频起诉了TikTok。

paragraphs.en: "Rules are now being established, so I hope everyone will follow them. It's all based on the premise that everyone will truly follow the rules,” Nozawa said of this ruling.
paragraphs.cn: 谈及这项判决，野泽雅子说：「现在规则正在建立，我希望大家都能遵守。这一切的前提，是每个人都真正遵守规则。」

paragraphs.en: Rather than relying on AI, Nozawa encourages fans to work hard to become voice actors themselves. "I want you to work hard so that you become someone people will definitely remember as a voice actor,” she said. “If you don't put your heart into it, you'll just be reading the lines, so make them come alive."
paragraphs.cn: 野泽雅子鼓励粉丝不要依赖AI，而是努力成为配音演员。她说：「我希望你们努力，成为让人们一定会记住的配音演员。如果不用心，就只是在念台词，所以要让台词活起来。」

paragraphs.en: Nozawa is vice-chairperson for the Japan Actors Union, which held a press conference on October 15 to discuss its new guidelines regarding AI voices. "The progress of AI is amazing, isn't it?” Nozawa said in a statement. “It feels like the things I dreamed of as a child are becoming reality one after another, and it excites me. But it's disillusioning when it's being used without permission. I hope that everyone will follow the rules and we can create a future where both humans and AI can have fun together."
paragraphs.cn: 野泽雅子担任日本演员联盟副理事长。该联盟于10月15日召开记者会，介绍新制定的AI声音使用指南。野泽雅子在声明中表示：「AI的进步很惊人，不是吗？感觉小时候梦想的事正一件接一件变成现实，让我很兴奋。但看到它被用于未经许可的用途，又让我感到失望。我希望大家都能遵守规则，共同创造一个人与AI都能乐在其中的未来。」

paragraphs.en: She isn’t the only prominent voice actor with something to say about AI; Toshi Shimada, best known for his role as Tomozo in the anime Chibi Maruko-chan, said that he “simply cannot accept the idea of ​​creating words I never said and songs I never sang, and then trying to monetize them. What I fear most is that the voice acting industry will collapse if unauthorized AI voices continue to be uploaded."
paragraphs.cn: 她并非唯一对AI发表看法的知名配音演员。以在动画《樱桃小丸子》中为友藏配音而闻名的岛田敏表示：「制造出我从未说过的话、从未唱过的歌，再试图靠这些赚钱，我实在无法接受。我最担心的是，如果未经授权的AI声音继续被上传，配音行业会崩溃。」

paragraphs.en: Michihiro Ikemizu, another prominent voice actor and Vice Chairman of the Union, explained that the “biggest problem is that people will lose their jobs. We want to build a track record with these guidelines and eventually aim for legislation."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位知名配音演员、同样担任联盟副理事长的池水通洋解释道：「最大的问题是人们会失去工作。我们希望通过这些指南积累实践成果，最终推动立法。」

paragraphs.en: This is the latest big news to come from AI voice acting after Amazon Prime Video caused a kerfuffle for introducing an AI-generated English dub of the anime Banana Fish back in 2025. The decision caused so much backlash that the streamer eventually removed it , but many fans felt that the fact it was included at all didn't bode well for the future of the dubbing industry.
paragraphs.cn: 这是AI配音领域的又一重大消息。此前，Amazon Prime Video曾在2025年为动画《Banana Fish》上线AI生成的英语配音，引发风波。这一决定招致强烈反对，平台最终撤下了该配音，但许多粉丝认为，平台居然会将它上线，本身就不是配音行业未来的好兆头。
